newsitem.title: FINLAND: INCAP SEES NET SALES GROWING IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: INCAP SEES NET SALES GROWING IN 1997.

text.p: Finnish electronics and furniture subcontractor Incap Oy said on Friday it expected its net sales to grow substantially and profitability to improve in 1997.
"The group's net sales are expected to continue to grow substantially this year," Incap said in a statement with its first quarter results.
"Profitability is also expected to develop favourably," it said.

Incap's Q1 turnover rose to 64.76 million from 59.95 million in the year-ago period. First quarter profits before extraordinary items and taxes rose 58 percent to 8.24 million markka from 5.22 million.
In 1996, Incap had net sales of 221.75 million markka and a pre-tax profit before extras of 10.40 million markka.
